concrete_defects.description: The selected metrics connection key is used to read its native entry, but its mode/vendor are not compared with the selected metrics context mode/vendor passed to linear_score_run. An exact canonical metrics owner from another connected tier/vendor passes family admission and can supply a different provider while execution flags retain the selected context values.
concrete_defects.repair: Compare metrics owner key against selected metrics mode and classical_metric_vendor before RUN. Preserve explicit-CPU estimator plus separately selected metrics-provider semantics; do not compare blindly against the estimator key.
concrete_defects.required_control: Replace the metrics entry connection with a genuine other-tier/vendor metrics owner and require refusal before execution. Keep absent tier/vendor conditions explicit.

proof_gaps.description: The borrowed LinearModelState fixture exercises the real host predictor directly through linear_predict_run. It bypasses linear_lease_predict and production linear-table lookup. Table-call fixtures and separate-image endpoint are synthetic. Consequently no standalone native fixture currently composes a production handle acquisition, production linear table entry, and predictor in one graph.
proof_gaps.scope: Does not imply a product defect. Authored public boundary tests exercise the integrated public chain after root execution; a direct native graph would supply the requested native composition proof.
proof_gaps.suggested_control: Retain explicit coefficient/input/output owners, publish the existing host predictor under the production estimator family key, call linear_lease_predict through an acquired LinearModelState lease, then retain/release/replace and check the literal result and stale-handle refusal.

observations_not_failures.description: Six GILReleased(Python()) sites match a pattern previously discussed during integration. No new compile was run; root notes this form also exists in the active prior build. This review does not classify these sites as compiler failures.

audited_findings.name: publication
audited_findings.finding: Publication mutates metadata under the slot lock, release-stores readiness only after copying all fields, and the reader acquire-loads readiness before reading immutable entries. Repeated publication requires identical publisher, tier/vendor, schemas, operation counts, and function pointer bytes.
audited_findings.limits: Source review only; no execution by this lane.

audited_findings.name: first_slot_creation
audited_findings.finding: New slot constructors only allocate native metadata/default containers. They create no device context or external registration, so the existing SharedSlot losing-initializer contract is respected.
audited_findings.limits: Relies on the existing SharedSlot/_Global runtime contract and recorded runtime evidence; this review did not disassemble or execute the runtime again.

audited_findings.name: slot_layout_and_route_identity
audited_findings.finding: SharedSlot checks layout version/size before returning a value. A source-map comparison finds 32 unique family/tier/vendor slot names and matching publication/read branch maps across eight tier/vendor conditions.
audited_findings.limits: Version/name discipline remains required for semantic or same-size layout changes. No mixed-image execution was performed.

audited_findings.name: publisher_roots
audited_findings.finding: All eight publishers retain the existing host/device callback functions and schemas, derive keys from compiled mode/vendor, and publish after module finalization during initialization. No new numerical implementation was introduced by these publication additions.
audited_findings.limits: Source review only; no execution by this lane.

audited_findings.name: canonical_connection
audited_findings.finding: Import connection admits exact compiled functions, requires metadata entries and factory to share the actual C-function owner module, checks expected descriptor ABI/count and published pointer, and retains the exact module in an opaque canonical owner. Runtime entry selection admits exact dictionary keys, owner type, and family.
audited_findings.limits: Source review only; no execution by this lane.

audited_findings.name: connection_replacement
audited_findings.finding: The main estimator admission cache includes canonical connection identity, so replacement rechecks selected tier/vendor. Weighted Ridge and OLS TSQR also compare their separate provider keys with the estimator key. Metrics omission is reported separately as NET-001.
audited_findings.limits: Source review only; no execution by this lane.

audited_findings.name: registry_metadata
audited_findings.finding: Insert/acquire validate under the metadata lock; acquire returns an owning Arc copied before unlock. No registry Dict entry borrow escapes to numerical execution.
audited_findings.limits: Source review only; no execution by this lane.

audited_findings.name: generations_and_replacement
audited_findings.finding: Release removes the registry owner and makes the index reusable; reuse increments generation, and exhausted UInt64 generations retire the slot. Replace leaves an already acquired Arc snapshot intact. Both release and replace retire previous owners after unlocking.
audited_findings.limits: Exhaustion/OOM exceptional paths are source-reviewed only; no fault injection or same-handle race execution occurred.

audited_findings.name: borrowed_buffers
audited_findings.finding: LinearModelState carries borrowed addresses, not ownership. Public prediction captures coefficient/scalar fields before argument admission can release the GIL, retains its own admitted coefficient/input/output pins and native Arc through RUN, and refreshes native state for supported coefficient replacement. Concurrent replacement cannot remove that call's explicit source pins.
audited_findings.limits: A registry handle alone does not extend an external exporter lifetime. New native meta-estimator callers must retain the buffer owners explicitly. In-place user mutation retains the existing borrowed-buffer semantics, not a new data-race guarantee.

audited_findings.name: image_and_owner_lifetime
audited_findings.finding: Connection objects pin the actual image directly, and public RUN finally blocks retain those objects independently of mutable entry dictionaries. State owners pin coefficients/means, release registry handles before dropping their pins, and register canonical retained-pin inspectors.
audited_findings.limits: Low-level native entry-table pointers themselves are not image owners. The separate-image fixture/controller must retain both loaded images through all calls, as its protocol specifies.

audited_findings.name: authored_proof_scope
audited_findings.finding: Authored coverage contains 20 native contracts, including 16-worker first-publication and registry stress subgraphs; generic separate-image publication/query/hold/release/schema/layout controls; and nine public-boundary definitions expanding to 22 cases, two conditional on another tier being installed.
audited_findings.limits: All were unrun in this review. Native stress covers independent handles and concurrent first publication; it is not a deterministic same-handle replace/release race proof, a GPU submission proof, or a complete production native composition proof (NET-P01).

conclusion: One concrete metrics key-admission defect and one native composition proof gap were sent to root. No additional concrete publication, handle-generation, replacement/release, or live-call pin defect was found within this bounded source review. This is not compile/runtime/performance acceptance.
